checks.name: No eval() usage in app code
checks.fix: Remove all eval() calls and use safer alternatives

checks.name: No innerHTML in app code
checks.fix: Use textContent or DOM APIs instead of innerHTML to prevent XSS

checks.name: Uses strict equality checks
checks.command: bash -c "grep -rn '[^!=]==[^=]' js/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v '===' | grep -v node_modules | wc -l | tr -d ' '"

checks.name: Catch blocks have error handling
checks.fix: Add proper error handling in all catch blocks

checks.name: Minimal console.log in production code
checks.fix: Remove or wrap console.log calls for production

checks.name: Alpine.js uses x-text not x-html
checks.fix: Replace all x-html with x-text to prevent XSS from RSS content

checks.name: No large blocks of commented-out code
checks.fix: Remove commented-out code blocks, use version control instead

checks.name: Uses var/let/const consistently
checks.fix: Document: this project uses var for ES5 compat (Alpine.js pattern)

checks.name: No JS files over 400 lines
checks.command: bash -c "for f in js/*.js; do lines=$(wc -l < \"$f\"); if [ \"$lines\" -gt 400 ]; then echo 0; exit; fi; done; echo 1"
checks.fix: Split files over 400 lines into logical modules
